rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The Learn more link inside EnterpriseAIDisclaimer has marginTop: 10px which pushes it outside the container's bounds. The container's paddingBottom (10px) was not sufficient to contain the Learn more link (24px height). Combined with the footer-disclaimer-shell's marginBottom (18px) and footer-bottom-bar's paddingTop (6px), the total gap (24px) was less than the Learn more link's overflow (34px = 10px marginTop + 24px height).
